character: weary female agama, sandy-orange hide, backwards cap, mouth used for speech only, thick tail, fills two thirds of the frame height
props: three fat toads with string bags - their place is her tail and her body, never the ground, until 6.9; a board with the number 399 in the ground beside the trail all clip, only digits on it; a motorcycle parked beside the trail all clip, black leather dress on its handlebar
motion_rule: the toads touch her every window until 6.9, never at a distance; she fights back every window - wrenching, kicking, elbowing - never merely walks; she drives her body at the lens until 6.9; new shot size every window
environment: dusty clay trail running to the lens, hard midday sun, hard shadows; background under a third

audio.delivery: weary female voice, native Russian stress
audio.pronunciation: stress: sbra-SY-va-yu, KHVOST, tya-zhe-LO, sbra-SY-va-ye-te, TSE-ny, ras-TUT
audio.pacing: brisk pacing, no drawling, every line fits its window
audio.lip_sync: mouth moves on every syllable, never a voice-over
audio.sfx: clay scraping, toad croaks, a dry pop as the tail tears, engine roar

timeline.a: drives out of the depth at the lens, the parked bike beyond | three toads clustered on her tail, bags ploughing dust
drives her shoulder back into a toad climbing her spine | it slides off, grip never loosening
two rolling strides, she boots the middle toad with a hind foot | its bag snags a stone, jerking her hip
leans into the pull, claws cutting two furrows | all three anchor back, one climbs her spine, shrugged off
throws her head into the lens, elbows the toad off her spine | it tears free, swinging, still on the tail
wrenches her hips, tears the cluster out of the rut, lunges on | all three swing out like a pendulum
drags the cluster right past the 399 board | the outer toad's bag slams it, the board shudders, she is shoved
one heave on both claws and the tail rips off at the base with a dry pop | all three ride the severed tail into the dust
freed, she springs onto her hind feet and snatches the leather dress off the handlebar | the three sprawl on the tail
pulls the dress on and swings a leg over the saddle, stump twitching | one toad hops after her and misses
stamps the kick starter, the rear wheel spins up a wall of dust | the dust rolls over the three on the tail
the bike leaps away into the depth past the 399 board | the toads are swallowed by the dust cloud
she shrinks into the dust far off | three toads sit holding the limp tail, mouths wide open, croaking at the lens

must_appear: toads on her tail, the 399 board and the bike from 0.0; a bag strikes the board at 5.2; the tail rips off at 6.15-6.9; she wears the leather dress from 7.5; the bike leaves into the depth at 8.8; the toads croak over the severed tail at 9.4
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, subtitles, captions, watermark, cyrillic, any letters on the 399 board, static camera, same shot size twice, only her head moving, a gap between her and the toads before 6.9, a window where the toads do nothing, the severed tail gone from frame, anything held in her mouth, deformed anatomy, character changing mid-shot, English speech, any word after 6.9, blood, props in mid-air
